battle.name: 唐攻契丹之戰
battle.brief: 開元十八年正月，契丹松模、可突干反唐，攻陷營州都督府屬縣，玄宗詔中書令張說、兵部尚書、幽州長史張守珪將兵十餘萬討之。張說屯幽州城東，以草車火炬焚陣前，火光沖天，契丹以為大軍齊至而潰，唐騎追擊斬首數千級。羅馬標槍不在此役裝備之列，其投刺破盾的工學與唐軍步槊、擲橛手同源，可作對照。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的一方是唐王朝。開元十八年正月，玄宗以中書令張說總制兵事，兵部尚書與幽州長史張守珪各領一路，發兵北討；兵源包括北衙禁軍、幽州與營州兩線的邊軍，以及河北道、河東道臨時募集的騎卒與隨軍丁夫，糧秣由幽州倉、營州倉支應，河北道漕運與民夫車馬負責接濟。另一方是契丹：松漠部與以太部在七世紀末形成部族聯盟，首領為松模與可突干，聯盟又聯結靺鞨與室韋，自草原與松漠方向南下。契丹與靺鞨並非國家，而是部族的軍事共同體，兵員由各部自徵，成分以輕騎為主，野戰裝備以弓矢、骨朵、長柄刀矛為主，營壘依山傍水築土城；室韋居地更北，多屬側面參與。雙方共享的邊境利益是營州、松州一帶的牧地、互市與反唐的政治號召，所以史書多以「契丹、靺鞨」連稱其行動，唐廷則視之為同一場邊患的兩翼。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Tang dynasty. In the first month of the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan, 730, Emperor Xuanzong placed the chancellor Zhang Yue in overall command, gave the minister of war and the governor of Youzhou, Zhang Shougui, one column each, and marched north to punish the raid. The troops came from the Northern Guard divisions of the capital, from the frontier garrisons of Youzhou and Yingzhou, and from horsemen and service levies hastily raised in the Hebei and Hedong circuits; grain and provisions were drawn from the depots of Youzhou and Yingzhou, while Hebei river transport, civilian carts and draft animals pushed the supplies forward. The other belligerent was the Khitan: by the end of the seventh century the two great divisions, the Songmo and the Yitai, had formed a tribal confederation headed by Songmo and Ketuogan, and the confederation drew in the Mohe and the Shiwei as it moved south out of the steppe and the Songmo plains. Neither the Khitan nor the Mohe was a state in any modern sense; each was a military community of tribes whose warriors were levied by the divisions themselves, mostly light cavalry, equipped for field work with bows, club-headed maces and long-handled knives and spears, and encamped in earthworks built beside hills and water. The Shiwei lay farther north and played a more marginal part. What the two sides shared at the frontier was the pasture of the Yingzhou and Songzhou region, the horse markets, and the political appeal of resisting Tang control, which is why the Tang histories nearly always write the two names together, while the court at Chang'an treated the whole rising as a single frontier war fought on two wings.
people: 唐方的指揮由三人分工。總制全局者是中書令張說，他自開元初年便參與對契丹的邊防議事，熟悉關外山川道里與季節風候，主張乘勢深入，不以擊退為滿足。與他同任元帥的兵部尚書領兵一路自平州、渝水一線北上，負責西翼的牽制；由於《新唐書》《舊唐書》《資治通鑑》對此人的姓名與分工記載互有出入，本文不強指其名。前線用兵者是幽州長史張守珪，他鎮守燕、代、營州一線數年，屢與契丹、靺鞨交手，熟知塞外草場、水源與風雪，戰後仍留鎮幽州，前後二十餘年。契丹方面的關鍵人物是松模與可突干：松模是部族聯盟的首領，可突干掌兵，開元十七年冬兩人聯手反唐，殺死契丹主李詩（此名各書寫法不一），攻陷營州都督府屬縣；開元十八年遭唐軍打散，兩人分頭逃回草原。此役之後的變化多與可突干有關，至於他其後的生死與繼任者，各書記載互有出入，僅知契丹的權力自此更形鬆散，直至天寶年間阿保機整合各部為止。玄宗李隆基是決策者，他力主出兵反制，並以宰相、尚書、刺史三層人事編組成行軍系統；此役之後他仍用張守珪鎮幽州，而張守珪麾下的胡將安祿山，也在開元二十四年隨軍征奚、契丹時嶄露頭角，數年後反成唐室心腹大患。
peopleEn: The Tang command was divided among three men. The overall director was the chancellor Zhang Yue, who had taken part in frontier discussions about the Khitan since the opening years of Kaiyuan, knew the roads, watercourses and seasonal weather of the country beyond the passes, and pressed for a deep pursuit rather than a mere repulse. The minister of war, who was co-commander with him, led one column north along the Pingzhou and Yushui line to hold the western flank in check; because the Xinyu Tangshu, the Jiutangshu and the Zizhi Tongjian disagree about this officer's name and about how the command was divided, this account does not insist on identifying him. The man who actually fought the forward battle was Zhang Shougui, governor of Youzhou. He had held the line of Yan, Dai and Yingzhou for years, had met the Khitan and the Mohe again and again, and knew the pastures, the waterholes and the snow-winds of the steppe; after this campaign he remained at Youzhou for more than twenty years. On the Khitan side the decisive figures were Songmo and Ketuogan: Songmo was one of the chiefs of the tribal confederation, Ketuogan held the troops, and in the winter of the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan the two joined hands in revolt, killing the Khitan ruler Li Shi (the name is written differently in different books) and seizing the counties of the Yingzhou governorship. In the eighteenth year they were broken by the Tang army and fled back into the steppe separately. Most of what followed turned on Ketuogan; as for the date and manner of his end and his successor, the sources differ, and only the looseness of the Khitan command in the years that followed can be stated with confidence, until Abaoji welded the divisions together in the Tianbao era. The decision-maker was Emperor Xuanzong, Li Longji, who insisted on military reprisal and built the expedition out of three tiers of personnel, chancellor, minister and prefect. He kept Zhang Shougui at Youzhou after the campaign, and the Hu general An Lushan under that command first showed his talent in the twenty-fourth year of Kaiyuan while campaigning against the Xi and the Khitan, only to become, a score of years later, the gravest danger to the house of Tang.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是羅馬標槍（pilum），成形於公元前一世紀末，是羅馬軍團步卒的標準投射兵器：槍身約半米，槍桿中空，槍頭是細長的加重鐵矛，安在木柄上；投擲時靠前端的鋼質矛頭配重增加射程與穿透力，命中盾牌後槍桿易折，敵兵往往只能帶著插在盾上的半截槍退回掩體，羅馬人因此得以反覆投射，維持持續而廉價的火力密度。必須說明的是，標槍與唐攻契丹之戰毫無直接關係，開元十八年唐軍的裝備名錄裡不會出現這種兵器，它之所以放在這場戰爭上，是因為它恰好代表「投射型破盾兵器」這一技術方向。與之最可對照的是唐軍步卒的標槊與擲橛手：唐制編制中步軍設有專門的擲橛手，執短標拋擲，作用正是壓制敵方盾面與遮蔽物；騎兵用馬槊直刺，步卒以步槊為長槍陣的核心，弩手用擘張弩與竹臂弩在陣前齊射，弓手以長弓覆蓋射界。契丹與靺鞨的裝備完全另一路數：輕騎配骨朵、佩刀與短角弓，矢鏃多為骨製，長柄矛用於步戰，護體靠皮兜鍪與皮札甲。攻城方面，唐軍帶著雲梯、撞車與配重投石之屬隨軍北進；後勤靠牛車、驛馬與民夫隊，把糧食自幽州、營州一路往北送。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman pilum, which took shape in the late first century BC and was the standard missile of the Roman legionary infantry: the shaft was about half a metre long and hollow, and the head was a long, heavy iron spike fitted to a wooden handle. In throwing, the weight of the steel head gave the missile range and penetration, while the hollow shaft was brittle enough to break after it struck a shield, so the struck enemy generally had to walk back behind his cover with half the weapon still fixed in the shield; the Romans could therefore keep throwing and maintain a steady, cheap volume of fire. It must be said plainly that the pilum had no direct connection with the Tang campaign against the Khitan, and nothing of the kind appears in the Tang supply lists of 730; it sits on this war because it happens to represent the technical line of the missile that breaks a shield. The closest counterparts in the Tang army are the biaoshao and the throwers of short javelins: the Tang establishment allotted the foot soldiers specialist javelin-throwers whose short missiles were thrown to beat down enemy shields and cover, the horsemen used the mashao for the straight thrust, the foot formed the core of the long-spear formation with the bushao, crossbowmen fired volleys of bow-armed and bamboo-armed crossbows in front of the line, and archers covered the ground with longbows. The Khitan and the Mohe were equipped along quite different lines: light horsemen with club-headed maces, sabres and short horn bows, bone arrowheads, long-handled spears for close fighting, and leather helmets and leather lamellar armour for protection. On the siege side, the Tang army marched north with scaling ladders, battering rams and counterweight stone-throwers; in the rear, ox carts, post-horses and teams of civilian porters dragged grain from Youzhou and Yingzhou northward step by step.
tactics: 唐軍採取分進合擊的部署：張說率主力出幽州，張守珪以本地邊軍出任前鋒與游騎，另有一路自平州沿渝水北上，企圖切斷契丹與靺鞨的聯繫，使兩部不能合兵。真正的決戰被刻意選在幽州城外的近地帶，把契丹最擅長的草原機動戰拉進唐軍弩、槊與騎兵包抄的射界內，這是張說最見功力的地方。開元十八年二月前後的關鍵一戰，張說在陣前預置大批草車，車上堆柴草與火炬，待契丹夜來進攻便一齊點燃，火光沖天、聲勢浩大，契丹兵以為唐主力已全數到齊，遂棄陣而走；唐軍隨即以精騎追擊，斬首數千級，可突干僅以數騎得脫。契丹與靺鞨的戰法仍是草原式的：不戀戰、不深入，游擊掠奪後迅速退回松漠，寧可放棄營州與松州的城邑也要保存人馬，因為他們清楚唐軍的糧道會隨深入而拉長，等到冬季河面封凍、草場封雪，遠征軍的補給與士氣都會下降。室韋多不與契丹正面合流，只在北方草原伺機而動，令唐軍不敢把全部兵力用在一處。唐軍的弱點也同樣明顯：糧秣依賴幽州、營州兩倉與河北道的漕運，車隊在河谷山道中行進緩慢，十餘萬大軍一旦深入，山谷內難以展開，只能靠騎兵周旋與前鋒的銳氣支撐戰局。
tacticsEn: The Tang army fought on a plan of separate columns advancing to converge. Zhang Yue led the main body out of Youzhou, Zhang Shougui took the front with the local frontier troops and a screen of raiding cavalry, and a third column moved north along the Yushui from Pingzhou with the object of cutting the Khitan off from the Mohe so that the two could not fight together. The decisive action was deliberately staged on the ground outside Youzhou city, where the steppe-style mobile warfare the Khitan excelled at could be drawn into the killing ground of Tang crossbows, spears and encircling cavalry; this was Zhang Yue's most striking piece of generalship. In the critical action of about the second month of the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan, Zhang Yue had a great number of straw carts posted in front of his line, loaded with brushwood and torches, and when the Khitan attacked in the night he fired them all at once, so that the light blazed up into the sky and the noise and glare suggested an army already assembled in full strength; the Khitan threw down their formation and ran, and the Tang cavalry pursued at once, cutting off several thousand heads, while Ketuogan escaped with only a handful of riders. The Khitan and the Mohe still fought in the steppe fashion: they did not stand and fight, they did not push deep, and after raiding they withdrew quickly back to the Songmo country, prepared to abandon the towns of Yingzhou and Songzhou rather than risk their warriors, for they understood that the Tang supply line lengthened with every day of advance, and that once the rivers froze and the pasture lay under snow, the provisions and the morale of a distant army would fail. The Shiwei usually did not close with the Khitan in a single battle but waited in the northern steppe, forcing the Tang to keep troops back from any single point. The weakness of the Tang force was just as visible: food depended on the depots of Youzhou and Yingzhou and on the river traffic of Hebei, the cart trains crawled through river valleys and mountain tracks, and once more than a hundred thousand men pushed inland they could not deploy in a valley, so the battle had to be sustained by the circling of cavalry and by the morale of the advance guard.
data: 關於數字，只能寫史書明確記載或有合理依據的部分。唐軍出動的兵力，《新唐書》與《舊唐書》均記為「十餘萬」，這是包含北衙禁軍、河北與河東募兵及隨軍丁夫的總數，實際投入前線作戰的兵力當遠少於此數，兩書都沒有分項記載。張說在幽州城外的火攻一戰，記「斬首數千級」，這是本役最常被引用的戰果數字。張守珪部的追擊，舊、新唐書記其追奔至營州以北的山地，地名寫作「木底山」者多，也有記載只寫「追至山北」，具體位置尚有爭議，同樣沒有留下確切的斬獲數。時間上，自開元十八年正月詔下出兵，到同年冬季契丹、靺鞨再度入寇、張守珪再挫其鋒，前後綿延逾半年；距離上，京師至幽州約一千二百里，幽州至營州約五百餘里，營州、松州一線再往北還有數百里的游牧地帶。戰役的實際接觸多發生在冬春之交，河北至遼西一帶此時常有暴雪與河川封凍，行軍與運糧都受影響。契丹與靺鞨的兵員數字在唐史中自相矛盾，多以「以數千騎來寇」一類的概數出現，無從核實，故不列具體數目；本役雙方的總損失、俘虜數與糧秣消耗，在現存史籍中同樣付之闕如。
dataEn: On figures, only what the histories record explicitly or what can reasonably be inferred may be given. The strength of the Tang expedition is given as more than a hundred thousand men by both the Xinyu Tangshu and the Jiutangshu; this is the total including the Northern Guard, levies raised in Hebei and Hedong and the service porters who marched with the army, and the number actually committed to the forward fight must have been far smaller, for neither book breaks the figure down. The action in which Zhang Yue fired the straw carts outside Youzhou is credited with cutting off several thousand heads, and this is the most frequently quoted result of the campaign. The pursuit led by Zhang Shougui is recorded in the Old and New Tang histories as driving as far as the hills north of Yingzhou, the place-name most often given being Mudishan, while other entries merely say that the pursuit continued to the northern hills; the exact site is still disputed, and no sure figure for the losses inflicted survives either. In time, the campaign runs from the first month of the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan, when the edict went out, to the winter of the same year, when the Khitan and the Mohe raided again and Zhang Shougui broke them a second time, a span of more than half a year. In distance, the capital lay about twelve hundred li from Youzhou and Youzhou about five hundred and more li from Yingzhou, with several hundred li of pastoral country beyond Yingzhou and Songzhou. The actual contact came in the transition from winter to spring, when heavy snow and frozen rivers were common between Hebei and western Liaodong and both marching and supply were affected. The Khitan and Mohe numbers in the Tang histories contradict one another, appearing mostly as rough expressions such as several thousand horsemen coming to raid, and cannot be checked, so no specific figure is given; the total losses on both sides, the number of prisoners and the tonnage of grain consumed are simply missing from the surviving records.
cause: 起火點在開元十七年冬。契丹在唐初內附，被分置於松漠與以太兩部，朝廷以封官、賜帳、編籍與互市羈縻之，部族之間的實力此消彼長，松模、可突干一批首領不滿於唐廷的羈縻安排，也擔心一旦朝廷改換對契丹的政策，部眾會被重編或遷徙。開元十七年冬，松模、可突干殺死契丹主李詩，眾心潰散，遂與靺鞨、室韋合兵，攻陷營州都督府屬縣，切斷了燕、代、營州一線的邊防與交通，也切斷了唐與渤海國往來的東向驛道。營州失守直接危及河北的門戶，朝廷無法容忍。玄宗在朝議上 面對的是一個兩難：容忍等於承認邊軍無力，討伐則要越過數百里草原、在冬季補給極差的條件下深入。開元十七年末至十八年初，張說等人以「乘其新敗、內部未穩」為由力主出兵，玄宗最終批准，詔以中書令張說總制、兵部尚書與幽州長史各領一路，拉開了開元十八年這場戰爭。根本原因還在於唐與契丹的結構性矛盾：唐要的是邊防安寧與羈縻體系的穩定，契丹要的是草場、互市與部族自主權，兩者在開元年間的東北亞並排而居，衝突早晚要來。
causeEn: The outbreak began in the winter of the seventeenth year of Kaiyuan. The Khitan had submitted to Tang at the beginning of the dynasty and were settled in two divisions, the Songmo and the Yitai; the court kept them in check through ennoblement, grants of livestock, registration of households and the horse-trade markets, and the balance of power between the divisions kept shifting. A group of chiefs including Songmo and Ketuogan resented the Tang arrangement of control, and feared that a change of policy would mean their people being re-enumerated or moved. In the winter of that year Songmo and Ketuogan killed the Khitan ruler Li Shi, the confederation broke up, and they joined with the Mohe and the Shiwei to seize the counties of the Yingzhou governorship, cutting the frontier and the roads of the Yan, Dai and Yingzhou line, and cutting the eastern post road between Tang and the kingdom of Balhae. The loss of Yingzhou threatened the very gateway of Hebei, and the court could not tolerate it. What Xuanzong faced in the council was a dilemma: to tolerate it would be to admit the frontier army was powerless, while to punish it meant crossing several hundred li of steppe in winter conditions, when supply would be at its worst. From the end of the seventeenth year into the eighteenth, Zhang Yue and his colleagues urged war on the ground that the enemy had just been defeated and was not yet reorganised; the emperor approved, and the edict went out with the chancellor Zhang Yue in overall command, the minister of war and the governor of Youzhou each commanding a column. That opened the campaign of the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan. The deeper cause lies in the structural contradiction between the two: Tang wanted a quiet frontier and a stable system of control, the Khitan wanted pasture, markets and freedom for their own divisions, and the two lay side by side in northeast Asia during the Kaiyuan era, so the collision was bound to come.
impact: 短期看，唐軍收復營州都督府屬縣，恢復了燕、代、營州一線的邊防，契丹與靺鞨退回松漠草原，河北與渤海之間的通道重新打開，玄宗對邊軍的信心與張說的權位都因此抬升，張說一度被視為解決契丹的第一人。但代價也立刻浮現：遠征消耗了幽州、營州兩倉的存量與河北道的民力，十餘萬大軍的糧秣自備不足時便轉嫁到沿邊州縣；張說隨後在朝中受到李林甫等人的排擠，開元十九年以「與王毛仲交結」等由罷中書令，外放為集賢院學士，總制契丹戰役的功勞反成了他人攻訐的柄。中期影響更為深遠：張守珪自此長期坐鎮幽州至開元二十四年，其麾下胡將安祿山隨軍征奚、契丹，以斬獲冒功，被張守珪笞打幾乎致死，卻由此嶄露頭角，二十餘年後由安史之亂掀翻了唐朝。長期看，這場戰役並沒有解決東北問題：契丹雖受挫，部族聯盟卻在內部權力真空與唐廷羈縻的雙重作用下不斷整合，天寶年間阿保機統一各部、控制室韋與渤海，到755年以傾國之師南下，唐朝由盛轉衰的起點，就在二十多年前幽州城外的這場火攻與追殺之後。學者常言，開元年間對契丹的軍事勝利恰恰加速了契丹自身的集權，因為唐廷每次出兵都在削弱周邊的小部族，而把契丹推成東北唯一的強權。
impactEn: In the short term the Tang army recovered the counties of the Yingzhou governorship and restored the frontier of the Yan, Dai and Yingzhou line; the Khitan and the Mohe withdrew to the Songmo steppe; the road between Hebei and Balhae opened again, and both the emperor's confidence in the frontier army and Zhang Yue's standing rose with the victory, Zhang Yue being treated for a time as the man who had settled the Khitan question. The cost showed at once as well. The expedition drained the depots of Youzhou and Yingzhou and the labour of Hebei, and where a force of more than a hundred thousand could not feed itself the burden fell on the counties along the frontier. Zhang Yue was then squeezed out at court by men such as Li Linfu and in the nineteenth year of Kaiyuan was removed from the chancellorship on charges that included keeping company with Wang Maozhong, being sent out to the Academy of Collected Wisdom; the very credit of directing the Khitan campaign became a handle with which he could be beaten. The middle-term consequence runs deeper. Zhang Shougui sat at Youzhou down to the twenty-fourth year of Kaiyuan, and the Hu general An Lushan under his command, campaigning against the Xi and the Khitan, claimed credit for kills that were not his and was beaten by his own commander nearly to death, yet it was this that first made his name, and a score of years later the An Lushan rebellion brought down the Tang. In the long run the campaign settled nothing in the northeast. The Khitan were checked, but their tribal confederation kept consolidating under the double pressure of an internal power vacuum and Tang control, and in the Tianbao era Abaoji united the divisions, brought the Shiwei and Balhae under his hand, and in 755 marched south with the resources of a whole people; the turn of the Tang from greatness to decline has its starting point in the fire and the pursuit outside Youzhou city more than twenty years earlier. Historians often observe that the military victories of the Kaiyuan era against the Khitan actually accelerated the Khitan's own unification, because every Tang expedition weakened the smaller tribes around them and pushed the Khitan into the position of the only great power in the northeast.
result: 就戰役本身而言，結果是唐軍在開元十八年取得了明確而實在的局部勝利：幽州城外的火攻與追擊打掉了契丹與靺鞨的先鋒，斬首數千級，可突干僅以身免，張守珪部的追擊更把戰線推到營州以北，營州都督府屬縣重歸唐室，契丹與靺鞨在這一冬春沒有能再深入營州。但勝利是有邊界的：唐軍沒有追上並消滅契丹主力，沒有奪取其草場，也沒有讓契丹臣服；契丹退回松漠之後仍然保有完整的部族聯盟與騎兵實力，十餘萬大軍出塞數百里便不得不因糧道與季節折返，深入止步於營州一線。這就形成了一個反覆出現的局面——唐軍能守住邊防，卻無法在草原上取得決定性勝利；每次出征都要耗盡河北的人力物力，而契丹在失敗之後往往以更緊密的聯盟重新站起來。從長時段看，這場戰爭是開元盛世邊防最後一批輝煌勝利之一，也是唐朝對東北由攻轉守、並最終被契丹反噬的起點之一。史料對本役的記載有明顯的詳略不均：幽州火攻一役記得較細，遠征距離、糧秣數量與雙方損失則多闕，因此上述數字只宜作量級的參考，不宜當作精確統計。
resultEn: As the campaign itself went, the outcome was a clear and solid local victory for the Tang in the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan. The fire and the pursuit outside Youzhou destroyed the advance of the Khitan and the Mohe, cutting off several thousand heads and leaving Ketuogan to escape with a few riders; the pursuit by Zhang Shougui carried the line as far as the hills north of Yingzhou; the counties of the Yingzhou governorship came back to Tang control; and through that winter and spring the Khitan and the Mohe were unable to penetrate again as far as Yingzhou. But the victory had its limits. The Tang army neither caught and destroyed the main body of the Khitan nor took their pastures nor brought the Khitan to submission. After withdrawing to the Songmo country the Khitan still possessed an intact tribal confederation and their full mounted strength, and an army of more than a hundred thousand men, several hundred li beyond the frontier, had to turn back because of the supply line and the season; the penetration stopped at the Yingzhou line. That produced the situation which repeated itself for the rest of the dynasty: the Tang could hold the frontier but could not win a decisive battle out on the steppe; every campaign exhausted the manpower and goods of Hebei, while the Khitan, after each defeat, generally stood up again as a tighter confederation. Over the long run this campaign was one of the last brilliant successes of the frontier in the Kaiyuan golden age, and also one of the points at which the Tang turned from attacking to defending in the northeast, before being counter-attacked by the Khitan. The sources for the campaign are uneven: the action with the straw carts outside Youzhou is recorded in some detail, while the distances covered, the tonnage of grain and the losses on both sides are largely missing, so the figures given above should be taken as orders of magnitude and not as exact statistics.
